page.notes: The marginal notes on the right are partly faint; the references in them are read with doubt and several abbreviations are marked [?]. The first small-type paragraph has no visible letter mark: it seems to continue the right-hand margin note beginning "(cui li", so it may carry the mark a. The superscript marks after "suo" and in the small-type notes are uncertain (c and d). Printed hyphens are kept as printed. Long s is written as s throughout.
